referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes a charger used for charging the Li-Ion battery of an electric passenger car. It is based on direct information from the Swiss manufacturer Brusa. The entries are given as a function of kg device. The specific charger which was used for this dataset weights 6.2 kg.; UUID: 0bcb4455-be14-3db5-82f4-59254b61884f
